ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Program Names
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious patterns in program names or folders that are often found in malicious samples or hacktools

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\CVE\\-202.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\CVE202.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\poc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\artifact\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\artifact64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\artifact\\_protected\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\artifact32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\artifact32big\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("obfuscated\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("obfusc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\meterpreter$"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*inject\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-CVE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pupy\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*payload\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*beacon\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PowerView\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bypass\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*obfuscated\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*obfusc\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*obfus\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*obfs\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*evil\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MiniDogz\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\_enc\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\shell\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\rshell\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*revshell\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\av\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\av\\_test\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*adrecon\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mimikatz\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\PowerUp\\_.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*powerup\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\a\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\p\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\1\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Hound\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*encode\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*powercat\\\.ps1.*")))
